name: Aivo Projects
description: Query registered local projects, register an existing directory, and immutably bind the current unscoped coding session.

toolGroups.name: Aivo Projects
toolGroups.description: Query registered projects, add an existing directory, and bind the current conversation to one project.

tools.name: aivo_projects_query
tools.description: Query or list Aivo projects and inspect the current session's project association. Use projectId for an exact visible project, or query/limit/cursor for bounded local search and pagination.

projectId.description: Exact project ID. Cannot be combined with query or cursor.

query.description: Optional local substring search over project name, description, and root path.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from a previous query result.

tools.name: aivo_projects_add
tools.description: Register an existing absolute local directory as an Aivo project. This never creates a directory or clones a repository and does not associate the session automatically.

rootPath.description: Existing absolute local directory to register.

tools.name: aivo_projects_associate
tools.description: Bind the current unscoped coding session to one exact project. The binding is permanent: it cannot be switched or detached. Use the projectId and rootPath returned by query or add.

rootPath.description: Exact returned project root path, repeated for stale-reference validation and user approval.
